notes.title: VOICELINE UPDATE
notes.content: [p]Hello,[/p][p][/p][p]After several weeks, the voiceline update is finally available![/p][p][/p][p]The main character is played by GodDoubleDamnit. Happy birthday to him![/p][p][/p][p]Other minor changes:[/p][list][*][p]Optimized the "SPAM E" menu[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the volume of some sounds[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I haven't been very consistent lately, and I apologize for that. I'm working on the biggest project of my entire career, and it's taking up a lot of my time, but you'll hear about it soon on my Discord![/p][p][/p][p]See you soon![/p][p]TheCourget[/p]

notes.title: Issue with Main Menu Information section (courgetland.fr becomes thecourget.fr)
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Yesterday, courgetland.fr became thecourget.fr, but this change broke the information section of the main menu.[/p][p][/p][p]There is a redirection issue with the subdomains of courgetland.fr, I won't go into details but it should be fixed quickly.[/p][p][/p][p]For now, you can access the documentation with [url="https://schizophrenia.thecourget.fr/informations/"]this link[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]TheCourget.[/p]

notes.title: Announcement: THEBOAT release date delayed.
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I'm sorry to announce that THEBOAT is now delayed, I'm really sorry.[/p][p][/p][p]For a few weeks now I have no motivation to do anything, I really try but nothing comes to me, I just stare at an empty Unreal Engine project, for a few hours, to close it.[/p][p][/p][p]I will not give any more dates to avoid a possible delay in the future.[/p][p]When it comes out, you will be notified a few days in advance via a Steam and Discord post.[/p][p][/p][p]I'll really try to take time for myself, I will update SCHIZOPHRENIA, but less frequently.[/p][p][/p][p]The new VOICELINES update should be ready in a few weeks, I don't have any exact deadline.[/p][p][/p][p]I don't really know what to do now, I hyped people over a thing I've never finished, and I'm really sorry.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for everything, thank you for the support,[/p][p]I hope you're going to like THEBOAT (I'll post some sneak peeks on the Discord Server),[/p][p]TheCourget.[/p]

notes.title: VOICELINE UPDATE
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone ![/p][p][/p][p]In a few weeks, I am going to redo all the voicelines, and add missing ones.[/p][p]The voices will now be in French, my voice actors are French, the quality will be better ![/p][p][/p][p]I'm redoing dialogues for several reasons:[/p][list][*][p]Quality[/p][/*][*][p]I've cut ties with the voice actor "I", I won't say more on the subject for the moment.[/p][/*][*][p]The diversity of characters I could add (me, mom, dad, the doctor, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]AI is a poor alternative[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The update should be available in a few weeks.[/p][p][/p][p]I will show the progress on my official Discord, that you can join below ![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for reading this,[/p][p]TheCourget[/p]

Sorry for the inconvenience,[/p][p]TheCourget[/p]

notes.title: Improve SCHIZOPHRENIA with Me !
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

I want to announce that I'm going to try to improve SCHIZOPHRENIA as much as possible, and I'll do it with YOU.

If you'd like to become a beta tester for SCHIZOPHRENIA and future games, here's what you need to do:

- Join the Discord (link below this post)
- Go to #announcements
- Click on the Beta Tester Google Form link
- Fill out the form and submit it

You can improve SCHIZOPHRENIA, the upcoming ARG, and future games with me !

You'll find more information on the beta testing form on the Discord server.

Thank you, I appreciate your interest in SCHIZOPHRENIA,
TheCourget.

notes.content:
Hello,

SOS.

TheCourget.

notes.title: More informations about the HonisLabs ARG Delay.
notes.content:
Hello,

As said in the previous post, the HonisLabs ARG will be released on June 25th.

I must apologize for that.

When creating the ARG, I underestimated the workload, and I'm sorry for that.

The website part is 100% finished.
The game part is not.

To apologize for the delay, I will regularly post images or videos of the game part of the ARG, on the #sneak-peeks channel of my Discord server, that you can join with the button below (More ways to connect).

I'll be very active in the Discord server, if you have questions, or if you wanna say hello, don't hesitate !

See you on June 25th, thank you for your patience.

TheCourget.

notes.title: HonisLabs ARG Available on June 25th.
notes.content:
Dear investigators,

We're very sorry to announce that HonisLabs will now launch on [b]June 25th[/b]. We need this extra time to polish the experience and ensure it's perfect for you. Thank you for your patience and understanding, see you soon !

The HonisLabs* Team, TheCourget.

*HonisLabs is a fictional pharmaceutical company.

notes.title: Controller Support Update Available !
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.

I'm proud to announce that you can now play SCHIZOPHRENIA with a Xbox controller,
from the main menu to the game ending.

It took a few days but it's now here !

I also fixed some small things.

Next update should be audio update or Steam achievements update.

I hope you'll like to play SCHIZOPHRENIA with a controller.

Note : PlayStation controller support is not planned for now.

Thank you for playing SCHIZOPHRENIA,
TheCourget.

notes.title: Controller Support Update Coming Soon.
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

I'm actually trying to release SCHIZOPHRENIA on consoles, but for now this is only an idea.

You can find more informations on the Discord server (link available in the game main menu or Steam page), there are also sneak peeks of a future project.

Thank you for playing SCHIZOPHRENIA,
TheCourget.

notes.title: Informations about SCHIZOPHRENIA.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Firstly,
Thank you.
I've seen a lot of videos of SCHIZOPHRENIA on social medias like YouTube, and it's crazy.

Secondly,
I've seen people complaining about stereotypes.
Yes,
SCHIZOPHRENIA is based on stereotypes and it does not reflect reality.
I'm sorry for this misunderstanding, so, an update is coming in a few days, to add a section in the main menu, to provide documentation and redirect to sites that will fully explain schizophrenia.

Thirdly, the game will fix and add many things in a future update, as :

- Remaking the second flashback
- Fixing crosshair glitches
- Fixing softlocking with the kitchen trash
- Optimizing the game
- Fixing some more stuff

Thank you,
TheCourget

And remember, [url=https://honislabs.com/]Attman was WRONG[/url].
